# Tabs

Swap between views of the same thing inside a page, such as a track's overview, plays and transitions, with an active line in the module colour.

`SongNodes.Tabs` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Tabs label="…" tabs={…} value="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Tabs" label="…" tabs="{{…}}" value="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (TabsProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | Accessible name of the tab list ("Track detail"). |
| `tabs` * | `{ id: string; label: string; count?: number; countLabel?: string; changed?: boolean }[]` | Tabs in fixed order. |
| `value` * | `string` | Selected tab id. |
| `onChange` * | `(id: string) => void` | Called with the new tab id (arrow keys select immediately). |
| `module` | `"graph" \| "library" \| "sets" \| "paths" \| "harmony" \| "sources" \| "pipeline" \| "services"` | Module whose colour draws the active line; falls back to brand. |
| `renderPanel` * | `(id: string) => unknown` | Render function for the panel of the selected tab. |
